### Hello World, I'm Stefanos!

I am a Biologist and PRINCE2-certified Project Manager. I combine a strong scientific foundation with advanced data science skills to bridge the gap between complex research and technical execution. 

Currently, I manage workflows and coordinate panel committees at the Hellenic Foundation for Research and Innovation (HFRI). Moving forward, I am actively seeking **remote Bioinformatics, Data Science, or Technical Project Management roles within the EMEA region** where I can dedicate the majority of my time to writing code, building pipelines, and analyzing data.

### Beyond the Screen

When I am not managing panels or writing code, you will usually find me outdoors walking, running, or hiking. I train in multiple martial arts—including Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, Kyokushin Karate, and Kickboxing—and I proudly serve as a volunteer Samaritan cadet with the Hellenic Red Cross.


:::
